pages.text: MathMod now has bounded collection runes for the first complex casting slice.$(br2)The Lift preset builds an entity_list, filters non-player living entities, sorts targets deterministically by distance, keeps a capped nearest subset, then creates and executes an effect_plan.

pages.title: New Runes
pages.text: $(li)nearby_entities(Vec3) -> EntityList$(li)filter_entities(EntityList) -> EntityList$(li)nearest_entities / farthest_entities$(li)entity_positions(EntityList) -> Vec3List$(li)count_entities(EntityList) -> Number$(br2)Lift costs 1 amethyst shard in survival.

pages.title: Blocks
pages.text: $(li)nearby_blocks(Vec3) -> BlockPosList$(li)block_positions(BlockPosList) -> Vec3List$(li)count_blocks(BlockPosList) -> Number$(li)average_position(Vec3List) -> Vec3$(br2)Block selectors accept any, air, block ids, block tags, or comma-separated selector lists.

pages.title: Regions
pages.text: Target and block lists can now be narrowed by a reusable Region value with filter_entities_in_region and filter_blocks_in_region.$(br2)Use this when one shape should drive more than one part of a spell.
